profile.org_note: Family-owned (J.F. Shea Co.) builder run by President and CEO Bert Selva from Walnut, CA, with eight division offices (Southern California, San Diego, Northern California, Arizona, Colorado, Houston, Carolinas, plus the national Trilogy Active Lifestyle division). Land is sourced and underwritten locally by each division (division VPs of land acquisition, land development and finance appear in Shea job postings) but every deal must be approved by a corporate land committee of senior management and J.F. Shea directors (2015 10-K, the last SEC filing); no corporate CFO, treasurer or head of land is named in any current public source.
profile.summary: Shea Homes is the homebuilding arm of the Shea family's J.F. Shea Co. and one of the largest private US builders: 2,605 closings and about $2.6B revenue in the 2026 Builder 100 (rank 34). It builds in 11 states through regional divisions and its Trilogy 55+ resort brand, and in Colorado and elsewhere acts as master developer selling lots to other builders. Land decisions start in the divisions and go to a corporate land committee, so the division presidents (several with land-acquisition backgrounds) and the corporate committee are the land banker's entry points.
